faq.q: How much does Elman Joseph Law Group charge?
faq.a: Elman Joseph Law Group publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Elman Joseph Law Group offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Elman Joseph Law Group publishes a free initial consultation.

faq.q: Where does Elman Joseph Law Group have offices?
faq.a: Elman Joseph Law Group publishes one office, in Chicago. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.
